notes.title: April 14th | Sort & Filter Song List
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38395262/532a5134395b0d9a98a69b2040bd656cb02013f4.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sort & filter menu
[*] Added delete button (it unrecoverably removes track and all its records; actual music files stay on disk)
[*] Added favorite button (star shaped), allows you to mark your favorite tracks and then filter for them
[*] Fixed: "best record" text was shown after any completed game, no it actually checks your time (oops)
[*] Fixed: on resolutions 1920x1080 and below connection guides weren't visible. Hopefully this will help new players to understand how blocks will connect.
[/list]

[h2]Screenshots of New Features[/h2]

You have to hold delete button with left mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38395262/30cde92f0d6a24f19f7f79e633083c14e5321f75.png[/img]

Filter and sorting have submenus. To add track to favorites click the star icon on the right of the track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38395262/3dd5e0995c31babfd83f0fec933b250c853137c9.png[/img]
